$comment: ILLUSTRATIVE until the board confirms: the Shariah board's standing positions for this institution (SR-025). Changed only through a maker-checker configuration revision (area BOARD_POSITIONS). The excluded goods are HS headings; the floor is the board's minimum risk-holding interval.

excludedGoods.description: Spirits, liqueurs and other spirituous beverages

lateAmounts.$comment: ILLUSTRATIVE until the board rules (Wasl W4b-2, 2026-10-21): the basis on which a late amount is computed, the grace after the due date, and the charities a collected late amount may be given to. A late amount is the distributor's undertaking to give to charity, held in the segregated charity liability and never the institution's income (SH-13); an assessment of inability suspends it (SH-14). The amount, the grace and the recipients are placeholders; the recipients are invented, with invented IBANs in the Saudi format. The board's ruling replaces all of it.

purification.$comment: ILLUSTRATIVE until the board rules (Wasl W6b-2, 2026-10-26; OI-12): how income from a defective transaction is fixed for purification — WHOLE_PROFIT (the transaction's entire profit) or ASSESSED_AMOUNT (a Shariah reviewer's assessment, never above the profit) — and the charities it may be given to. Confirmed by a second reviewer; raised to the charity liability as the profit is collected. The recipients are invented, with invented IBANs in the Saudi format.
